_note: All tunable numbers. Fields starting with _ are notes for humans and are ignored by the game. Values marked REAL come from NASA data; everything else is game balance and can be tweaked freely.

mission._msPerSol: Real time a sol takes when left running. 'End sol' fast-forwards the rest in fastForwardMs.

grid._jitter: How ragged the edge of the buildable area is. 0 = perfect circle.

start._start: Supplies landed with the crew, in kg (battery in kWh). buildings = free starter kit next to the habitat. Metal comes from the sector's cargo plus scavenging.

crewPerSol._oxygen: REAL: NASA life support baseline, about 0.84 kg O2 per person per day.
crewPerSol._water: APPROX: drinking + food prep only, no showers. Verify against NASA BVAD before demo.
crewPerSol._food: APPROX: packaged food mass per person per day. Verify against NASA BVAD before demo.

radiation._baseMsvPerSol: REAL: Curiosity RAD measured ~0.64 mSv/day on the surface (Hassler et al., Science, 2014).
radiation._doseBudgetMsv: GAME RULE: share of NASA's 600 mSv career limit given to this surface stay.

shielding._shielding: Each level of regolith on the habitat cuts solar storm dose by 25% bu everyday cosmic-ray dose by only 5%. That matches reality: cosmic rays are very hard to block.

failure._failure: Mission fails if the habitat had no power on 2 of the last 5 sols. One bad sol is survivable, repeated ones aren't.

rover._rover: Trips are timed in Mars hours (1/24 of a sol). Each trip takes its energy from the battery when the rover leaves: no charge, no trip.

discovery._discovery: Every everyHours Mars hours, rovers spot a new meteorite at least minDistance tiles from the habitat. Skipped if maxActive unclaimed metal nodes already exist.
